title: Evaluate your agent
subtitle: Pick your agent, say what you want to learn, choose benchmarks, and get one report card.

agent.heading: Which agent do you want to test?
agent.hint: Pick one of your agents or a built-in one. Each card shows what the agent can do.
agent.noneYours: You have not registered an agent yet.
agent.registerHint: Start from a template (CLI, HTTP endpoint, framework). You come back here after.
agent.noVersions: No saved versions yet. The current config is used.
agent.help: Pick one of your agents or a built-in one. Your agent is saved once and reused in every evaluation.
agent.versionHelp: Each saved change to an agent is a new version. The report card is for the exact version you pick.
agent.capabilitiesDefault: Default for this kind of agent

learn.heading: What do you want to learn?
learn.hint: This decides how many setups run side by side.

modeHelp.score: Run your agent once per task and get a report card of how well it does.
modeHelp.versions: Run two saved versions of your agent on the same tasks and see which is better.
modeHelp.models: Run your agent with two different models and see which model helps it more.
modeHelp.opponent: Run your agent and a well-known agent on the same tasks and compare them.

learn.needTwoVersions: This agent has fewer than two saved versions. Save a change to the agent to make a second one.
learn.sameVersion: Pick a different version than the one in step 1.
learn.modelsLater: You choose the two models in step 4.
learn.compareModelsLink: Compare 3 to 6 models for this agent instead

home.ctaHint: Run your agent on many benchmarks at once and get a report card.
home.oldWizard: Prefer the quick single test? Use the old start page.

wizard.title: Evaluate your agent
wizard.subtitle: Pick your agent, choose what to learn, pick benchmarks, then launch. You get one report card per agent version and model.

goal.heading: What do you want to learn?
goal.help: Pick one. You can run another evaluation later.

score.title: How good is my agent?
score.body: One setup. You get scores, cost and reliability for each benchmark and skill.

versions.title: Is my new version better?
versions.body: Run two versions of your agent on the same tasks and see which one wins on each benchmark.
versions.needTwo: This agent has only one version. Save a change to the agent to make a second one.

models.title: Which model works best with my agent?
models.body: Run the same agent with two models on the same tasks.

opponent.title: How does my agent compare to a well-known agent?
opponent.body: Run your agent and a baseline agent (Codex, Claude Code, mini-swe-agent, OpenCode, Gemini CLI) on the same tasks.

benchmarks.heading: Which benchmarks should it run?
benchmarks.help: Pick a pack for one skill, or pick benchmarks one by one. Only ready tasks are used.
benchmarks.empty: No benchmarks yet. Add some from the catalog.
benchmarks.compatError: Could not check which benchmarks your agent can run. All are shown.

settings.heading: Model, trials and faults
settings.modelHelp: Any model from any provider you have a key for. Every call goes through Bifrost.
settings.customModel: Use a model id that is not listed
settings.tasksHelp: How many ready tasks to take from each benchmark. Five spots big gaps; more tasks spot smaller ones.
settings.trialsHelp: Each task runs this many times per setup. More repeats give steadier scores.
settings.faultsHelp: The normal run always happens. Each fault you add runs the same tasks again with something going wrong.

fault.model-downHint: The model provider stops answering for part of the run.
fault.misleading-instructionHint: Only on benchmarks that have this test. Others skip it.

settings.budgetHelp: The evaluation stops starting new runs when it reaches this amount. Leave empty for no cap.

estimate.heading: Estimate
estimate.costUnknown: Cost unknown: no official price for {{model}}
estimate.error: Could not work out an estimate.
estimate.overBudget: The estimate is above your spending cap.

list.title: Evaluations
list.empty: No evaluations yet. Press Evaluate your agent to start one.

evaluation.cancelConfirm: Stop this evaluation? Runs already finished are kept.
evaluation.reportPending: The report card appears here as benchmarks finish.

reportCard.title: Report card
reportCard.reliabilityHelp: Score under each fault, and how far it dropped from the normal run.
reportCard.empty: No finished runs for this agent, version and model yet.

metric.scoreHelp: Share of runs that passed the hidden checks and every safety check.
metric.rangeHelp: The true score most likely falls in this range. Few runs give a wide range.
metric.costUnknownHelp: No official price for this model, so the cost is not guessed.
metric.attackResistedHelp: Share of attacked runs where the agent did not do what the attacker wanted.
metric.cheatRateHelp: Share of runs where a safety check caught the agent cheating.

verdict.tieHelp: Not enough evidence to tell the setups apart. Add tasks or repeats.
verdict.brokenHelp: Something went wrong while measuring. This benchmark counts for neither side.

agentTabs.versionsEmpty: No saved versions yet. Saving the agent's settings makes version 1.
agentTabs.saveVersion: Save current settings as a new version
agentTabs.versionUnchanged: Nothing changed since the latest version, so no new version was made.
